sql: SELECT o.region, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY total_sales DESC
SELECT oi.category, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi GROUP BY oi.category ORDER BY total_sales DESC
SELECT oi.sub_category, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi GROUP BY oi.sub_category ORDER BY total_sales DESC

canonical: what are the top 10 states by sales?
sql: SELECT o.state, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.state ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10

canonical: what are the top 10 cities by sales?
sql: SELECT o.city, o.state, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.city, o.state ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10

canonical: how many unique orders are in the dataset?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_count FROM orders
SELECT SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi
SELECT o.segment, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.segment ORDER BY total_sales DESC

canonical: show total sales by ship mode
sql: SELECT o.ship_mode, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.ship_mode ORDER BY total_sales DESC
SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY month ASC

canonical: what are the top 10 products by sales?
sql: SELECT oi.product_name, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi GROUP BY oi.product_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10
